source.author: John Henry Comstock
source.credit: After Comstock 1918, The Wings of Insects, fig. 362 (scan leaf n394)

derivative.note: Centre-line tracing of a scanned printed figure (archive.org wingsofinsectsex00coms, PDF page 395); lines were found automatically (ridge filter, skeleton, smoothing) and are not redrawn by hand. No names are assigned. The print carries Comstock–Needham vein lettering; it is visible in the scan underneath but is not transcribed.
derivative.license: unknown (source is public domain; the licence of the EntoWing tracing has not been set)
derivative.attribution: John Henry Comstock (1918), fig. 362; tracing by EntoWing
derivative.precision: Douglas–Peucker 1.7 px on a 300 dpi scan, then Catmull–Rom smoothing; check against the scan

provenance.familyAsPrinted: Psychodidae (named in the text referring to Fig. 362)
provenance.familyBasis: Comstock's text cites 'the Psychodidae (Fig. 362)'; the genus is not given.
notes: Veins are drawn as double outlines in the print; the tracing follows one side or the middle, and some basal veins are incomplete.
